Based on automotive interior designRealize driving information translation

Driver Information Module (DIM) is mainly used to display vehicle information display, including speedometer, fuel, electricity and other vehicle information. With the development of automotive technology, automotive instruments are constantly evolving and upgrading.With the development of technology, the instrument will be more and more inclined to digital display, and the traditional instrument panel is gradually replaced by full liquid crystal.

In the future, the instrument will become an important part of the car intelligence, it can not only provide rich information for the driver, but also through intelligent technology to achieve more convenient operation, bring more intelligent driving experience.
Given the high demand for transparency of assisted driving functions and driving safety information triggered by advances in autonomous driving technology.

Vehicle dashboard information has different display priorities in different scenarios, which depends on the driver's "top-down" demand for controlling vehicle information and the "bottom-up" safe vehicle information for protecting driving safety.With the development of vehicle driving technology, intelligent driving systems can help drivers complete different levels of information processing, which will change drivers' needs for driving and information presentation.

Through the interior line lighting to replace the traditional information display.
Information stratification allows the driver to feel the driving state of the vehicle more intuitively and simplifies the driver's attention allocation.

Using interior lighting as a medium, the driving state of the car is translated to the driver in the form of abstract lines.   The speed, color and shape of the lines match the driving information of the vehicle.

In the consideration of driving safety, the timely monitoring and processing of information outside the car is an important information that needs to be understood in the process of automatic driving.
